strategy.title: No plan: the counted market cannot carry $2,000,000
strategy.why: The only opening (vet controlled-substance reconciliation workbook, $450, sourced) sells into 1,200 licensed clinics. Even if every clinic bought, revenue is $540,000, about 27% of the $2,000,000 target; at the evidenced 12% conversion (36/300) it is ~144 deals = $64,800. No other opening is held.

alternatives.title: Sell the workbook to all reachable vet clinics
alternatives.why: Sound chain (sourced price, demand, Brain-produced spreadsheet, 4-day time to cash) but capped at $540,000 even at 100% uptake.

steps.label: Discover further openings/buyer populations; otherwise owner relaxes target

sources.claim: 1,200 veterinary clinics are licensed by the state board; each must reconcile its controlled-substance log quarterly.
sources.population: Licensed vet clinics in the state

noPlan.decisiveGap: MARKET_VOLUME: the only opening's whole counted market (1,200 clinics x $450) totals $540,000, below the $2,000,000 target, and no other opening is held.
noPlan.resolution: Lower the target to what the opening can carry (at most $540,000 at full uptake; ~$64,800 at the evidenced 12% conversion within 14 days), or have Brain discover additional openings/markets that together cover $2,000,000.

constraints.suggestion: Lower the target to about $64,800 (evidenced 12% conversion of 1,200 clinics at $450), never above the $540,000 full-uptake ceiling
